text_solutions.text:
"Question Explanation: Identifying the fundamental reason all life is interconnected.
Concept: Unity of Life (Common Ancestry).
Solution: All living organisms are linked because they evolved from a common ancestor. This shared ancestry is evident because all life forms use the same basic type of genetic material (nucleic acids like DNA) to store and transmit hereditary information. Final Answer: 2"

qns_content.text: "<div style=\"text-align:justify\">What is the practical significance of taxonomy ?<\/div>\n"

learning_objectives: "<div style=\"text-align:justify\">What is the practical significance of taxonomy ?<\/div>\n"

text_solutions.text:
"Question Explanation: Understanding the main purpose of taxonomy.
Concept: Practical Application of Taxonomy
Solution: The practical significance of taxonomy is the identification of unknown organisms. Taxonomy provides a structured system for naming, describing, and classifying all living things. Without this system, it would be impossible for scientists to accurately identify and communicate about the vast diversity of organisms on Earth. All other options, such as the general study of living things or structures in organisms, are a part of or a result of this primary function.
Final Answer: (2)"
